data.title: Traffic fine (Bußgeldbescheid) – red light violation
data.summary: The Bußgeldstelle of Landkreis Musteruckermark fined Ronny Musterspree a total of €232.00 (Geldbuße €200.00 plus fees) for running a red light on 17 October 2026 in Musterprenzlau, and noted 1 point in the Fahreignungsregister. The notice was delivered by registered post (Postzustellungsurkunde) on 24 November 2026.
data.explanation: This is an official fine notice (Bußgeldbescheid) for a red-light offence. You may object (Einspruch) in writing or in person at the issuing office; the app shows the deadline based on the delivery date stamped on the envelope. If you let the deadline pass without objecting, the notice becomes final and the full amount (€232.00) becomes due two weeks after that — the app cannot show that later date until it is known whether you objected. If you think the fine is wrong, consider getting advice (e.g. from a traffic lawyer) before the deadline shown. Otherwise, be ready to pay once the notice becomes final.

items.title: Decide whether to object (Einspruch) to the fine
items.action: Decide whether to file a written objection (Einspruch) against the Bußgeldbescheid, or submit it in person at the Bußgeldstelle, by the deadline shown.
items.consequence: If no objection is filed in time, the notice becomes final (rechtskräftig) and the fine becomes enforceable.
items.quote: Er muss zwei Wochen nach der Zustellung beim Landkreis Musteruckermark – Bußgeldstelle vorliegen, schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift.

items.title: Pay the total fine once the notice becomes final
items.action: If you do not object (or your objection is unsuccessful), pay the total amount of €232.00 two weeks after the notice becomes final; the app will show the exact due date once that is known.
items.consequence: Unpaid fines can lead to enforcement measures (Vollstreckung) against you.
items.quote: Fällig wird der Betrag zwei Wochen, nachdem der Bescheid rechtskräftig geworden ist.
